tables.name: Recruitment Type
tables.description: The preferred method of enlistment (not necessarily the only one).

results.name: Mercenary
results.description: The force is bought and paid for until such time as their contract ends, at which point the mercenaries renew or move on.

results.name: Mandatory
results.description: Law states all able-bodied citizens must spend a certain amount of time serving in the military.

results.name: Volunteer
results.description: Forces are made up of individuals who joined up willingly, and of their own volition.

results.name: Hand-Picked
results.description: The capital hand picks individuals from its populace, based on certain criteria.

results.name: Criminals
results.description: Convicts are enlisted, either as a compulsory part of their sentence or, quite possibly, voluntarily, as a way of commuting their sentences.

results.name: Conscripted
results.description: Troops are levied from regions owing fealty to the capital. This type of conscription is typically for a specific purpose which, once fulfilled, disbands, so troops can return to their homelands.
